text:
Priya: Hey all — quick scrub of INC-847 postmortem action items. I pulled the cross-team list and assigned what looked right, but need confirmations and dates.

Priya: Proposed roster:
- root-cause doc: Matt (due 2024-05-08)
- logs retention improvements: Lukas (due 2024-05-15)
- alert tuning + playbook update: Sophie (due 2024-05-10)
- customer comms follow-up: Amy (due 2024-05-07)
- rollback automation PR: Ben (due 2024-05-09)

Priya: Please confirm or propose different owners/dates. If you need extra time, say so and give a new ETA. @infra-bot: can you create JIRA tickets for any missing items? :pray:

Matt: Ack. I can take root-cause doc. 2024-05-08 works for me. I'll link notes to the RCA doc and cc eng-sre.

Lukas: I can own logs retention but need eng-infra help for the S3 lifecycle policy change. Can we make it 2024-05-20 instead? There's a dependency on the infra rollout window.

Sophie: Alert tuning is fine but can I push to 2024-05-12? Need one more pass with oncall to validate thresholds.

Amy: I can do customer comms follow-up. Quick Q — do we want a single consolidated email or per-customer notes? I can draft a template by 2024-05-07 and await PRs.

Ben: I'll pick up the rollback automation PR but need a review from eng-platform on the safe-guard tests. Target 2024-05-11 to give time for review.

Priya: Noted. Updated list:
- root-cause doc: Matt (2024-05-08)
- logs retention improvements: Lukas (2024-05-20) -> depends on infra rollout
- alert tuning + playbook update: Sophie (2024-05-12)
- customer comms follow-up: Amy (2024-05-07) -> draft template
- rollback automation PR: Ben (2024-05-11) -> needs eng-platform review

Priya: @Lukas please tag the infra change as a blocker in the JIRA and add the rollout window there.

Lukas: Will do. Also adding acceptance criteria: old logs must be retrievable for 30 days during migration. Posting snippet:
```
S3 lifecycle: transition to IA after 7d, expire after 90d. Migration window: 2024-05-18..2024-05-19
```

Matt: One more ask — can someone own a short verification run after rollout? 1-2hr smoke test. Happy to coordinate but need an owner.

Sophie: I can run the smoke tests for alerts once logs retention is stable. Add me to the ticket.

Amy: For comms: single consolidated email + per-customer followups where needed. I'll draft and share as a Google doc.

Ben: Dev ping — @eng-platform PTLs, can someone review the rollback PR next week? I'll post the branch link here when ready.

postmortem-bot: Created tickets JIRA-2145, JIRA-2146, and JIRA-2147 for the items without existing tickets.

infra-bot: Created ticket JIRA-2146 (logs-retention) and scheduled a tentative rollout for 2024-05-18 in the infra calendar.

Priya: Perfect. Final ask: owners, please update the JIRA ticket with a brief plan and acceptance criteria by EOD tomorrow so we can lock the cross-team schedule.

Matt: Done — I'll add the doc link and checklist.

Lukas: Adding acceptance criteria now.

Sophie: Will update playbook and post PR link by tomorrow.

Ben: I'll request reviews and tag eng-platform once branch is ready.

Amy: Drafting comms, will share doc link in this thread when ready.

Priya: Thanks everyone — if any dates slip, please update the ticket and ping this thread. :thumbsup:

Matt: :thumbsup:

Lukas: :+1:

Sophie: :raised_hands:

Ben: Thanks — will follow up on PR review cadence.

Amy: Shared doc: https://docs.google.com/example/draft-comms

Priya: Closing the scrub for now. Will reopen if blockers surface before EOD.
